stories.title: Cubs Sign Sato + Rogers — $240M Pre-Lockout Spending Spree Replenishes Rotation and OF

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
The Cubs just spent $240M in 24 hours.

Teruaki Sato: 6yr/$120M (Central League Triple Crown — .306 BA, 39 HR, 106 RBI)
Trevor Rogers: 5yr/$120M (10-11, 4.03 ERA)

That's two answers to losing Suzuki and replacing the rotation. Statement. #Cubs

x_posts.text: Japan's Triple Crown winner is a Cub. Teruaki Sato led the Central League in batting (.306), homers (39) and RBI (106) this season. He's 27, he's a lefty bat, and he fits the corner OF spot Suzuki left behind. #Cubs #MLB

stories.title: MLBPA Fires Back on Latest CBA Proposal — Calls It "Anti-Player Restrictions"; Lockout Looks Inevitable

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
MLBPA called MLB's latest CBA proposal "anti-player restrictions." Owners fired back: no deal without a salary cap.

6 days until Dec. 1 deadline. A lockout starting Dec. 2 is now nearly certain. 2027 season at risk if 99-day 2021 precedent repeats. #MLB #CBA

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
MLB's latest offer: delay cap to 2028, $258.3M cap, $180.2M floor, raise minimum salary to $1M.

The union rejected it immediately. Commissioner Manfred: owners won't sign any deal without a cap.

We're heading for a lockout. #MLB #CBA
